tagline: Hong Kong取景器相机，1981 年发布
description: Hong Kong于1981年推出的取景器相机。配备5.6 (four elements, coated)。快门速度1/50 second (with flash); 1/90 (without)。

specs.英文简介: Basic fixed focus 35mm viewfinder compact made in Hong Kong for the British brand Nova Cameras, from 1981.Review, compared to the Agfa Optima Flash, in [https://archive.org/details/b19974760M5509/page/394/mode/1up The Chemist and Druggist], 5 September 1981, pp394-6; at Internet Archive.
